zh.title: 发布说明
items: **0.1.0-rc.34** 精简任务界面，接入 GPT-6.1 Terra，并修复旧任务停止确认与目录资源释放的收尾。正式版仍为 0.0.18。

zh.title: 新功能与优化
items: 任务详情默认仅显示当前状态、简短进度和「打开完整任务」。创建信息、核验、证据、历史、追问和取消操作按需展开；任务更新保留用户的展开选择，切换任务默认收起。
ChatGPT 订阅候选目录新增 **GPT-6.1 Terra**，沿用现有 Responses 调用链，补齐视觉、推理档位、缓存及长上下文计价信息。已有模型和默认选择保持；上下文选项是本地预算，不代表所有订阅账号的上游能力保证。
主 Bot 输入框复用 Frost 输入表面与柔和阴影，增强悬浮层次，保留原有尺寸、草稿、附件与输入行为。
同步双语发布说明、站点更新日志与预览版版本入口。

zh.title: 修复
items: 识别有完整宿主审计的旧取消，以及 Worker 与核验均已结束却残留接管标记的任务，重新经过停止屏障并结清可释放资源。
停止等待到诊断期限后，随后真实完成的执行仍可提交回执并继续收尾；已结清回执允许幂等恢复，不因资源版本递增而永久停住。
资源恢复先重放匹配的停稳回执；相同未知结果保护不再不断刷新版本。活跃句柄、未知调用和新执行代次继续受到保护，不按时间或任务文本直接解锁。
当前停止、资源阻塞与核验进度优先于历史说明；缺少新进度时明确提示，不把任务指令当作执行进展。

zh.title: 升级与范围
items: 延续 RC33 的联合协调格式 9；升级前保留完整数据备份，并使用匹配版本的 Desktop、CLI/TUI 与 Gateway。
停止与资源恢复只处理可核对的受管执行事实，不抹除历史未知结果、不自动重放未知写入，也不把发布、模型文字或任务终态当作执行成功或签收。

en.title: Release notes
items: **0.1.0-rc.34** simplifies task details, adds GPT-6.1 Terra and repairs legacy stop confirmation and directory-resource settlement. Stable remains 0.0.18.

en.title: What's new and improvements
items: Task details initially show only current status, a short progress preview and Open full task. Metadata, verification, evidence, history, follow-up and cancellation controls open on demand. Updates retain disclosure state; switching tasks starts collapsed.

Add **GPT-6.1 Terra** to the ChatGPT subscription catalog through the existing Responses adapter, with vision, supported reasoning levels, cache and long-context pricing metadata. Existing models and defaults stay selected. Context presets are local budgets, not guarantees of every subscription account's upstream capacity.
Give the main Bot composer a clearer floating surface with existing Frost surface and shadow tokens, preserving geometry, drafts, attachments and input behavior.
Synchronize bilingual release notes, the website changelog and preview-version entry points.

en.title: Fixes
items: Reconcile audited legacy cancellations and takeovers left stopping after both worker and verifier returned, using the existing stop barrier before settling resources.
A real execution completion after the diagnostic stop deadline can still persist its receipt and finish settlement. Settled receipts remain replayable after resource revisions advance.

Replay matching durable stop receipts before importing resource protection. Rechecking an unchanged unknown hold no longer creates artificial revision churn. Live handles, unknown calls and newer execution generations remain protected.
Current stop, resource and verification facts outrank historical notes. Missing progress is explicit; task instructions never substitute for execution progress.

en.title: Upgrade and scope
items: Retain RC33's combined coordination format 9. Keep a complete data backup and use matching Desktop, CLI/TUI and Gateway versions.
Recovery uses verifiable managed-execution facts. It does not erase unknown history, replay unknown writes, or treat publication, model text or task status as execution success or acceptance.
